entities.title: Worker and rooms
entities.summary: The Cloudflare Worker: creates rooms, routes each room's WebSocket to its Durable Object, and serves the page under BASE.
entities.purpose: index.ts handles every request (run before the assets): POST {BASE}/api/rooms finds a free four-letter code, {BASE}/ws/CODE goes to that code's Room, and every other GET or HEAD is a file from dist/ with a strict Content-Security-Policy. room.ts is the Room Durable Object, which holds one game and every device's socket.
boundaries: No sign-in and no database (see games/kvardinn/.dev/decisions.json).
The rules are src/engine's; the room only feeds them messages and sends out their views.
codes.ts is its own module because the Worker's main module may export only the handler and the Durable Object.
